sections.title: Verbs with the same structure
sections.content:
Verbs like *encantar* (to love / to enchant) and *interesar* (to interest) work exactly like *gustar*:
- *Me encanta el arte* (I love art)
- *Me encantan los idiomas* (I love languages)
- *Me interesa la historia* (I am interested in history)

items.english: I am interested in different cultures.

items.spanish: A Meg le encantan los tacos.

sections.content: Do NOT say *Me encanta mucho*. *Encantar* already means to like very much, so *mucho* is redundant!
